newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish insurer Topdanmark shuts bank unit.
newsitem.headline: Danish insurer Topdanmark shuts bank unit.

text.p: Danish insurer Topdanmark announced on Monday that its Topdanmark Bank unit had gone into voluntary liquidation as part of its new strategy to concentrate on core insurance activities.
"The liquidation of Topdanmark Bank is part of Topdanmark's strategy to concentrate its business activity on Danish insurance," Topdanmark said in a statement.

Topdanmark said last June that it planned to shut down its bank and transfer its customers to BG Bank, with whom it is allied in a financial supermarket. Leading mortgage lender Nykredit A/S is also part of the pact.
Topdanmark's liquidation was effective immediately, Topdanmark said.
Topdanmark is Denmark's third largest insurance group and BG Bank is the country's third biggest bank.
